Wool & silk underwear for every season

Closetoskin underwear is knitted from natural fibres that work with your body: wool to keep you warm and dry, silk for a smooth, light feel against the skin. Choose a thin-strap camisole as an invisible base layer, a tank top for more coverage, or a long-sleeve top and turtleneck for the coldest days.

Every piece comes in sizes S, M and L with a close, second-skin fit, in timeless colours like black, ivory, ash grey and powder. Not sure where to start? Read our wool & silk guide.
